records.title: Records
records.lead: A quiet moment for music — slow down, and listen your way back to yourself.
records.footnote: The music keeps playing when you leave this page — a small card appears bottom-right to keep hold of it. The mood playlist plays 30 seconds per track; the resident set is public-domain and plays in full.

player.seek: Record: click a groove to jump there — the outer edge is the start
player.hint: Click any groove to jump there. With the record focused: space plays or pauses, arrow keys skip 5 seconds.
player.residentCredit: The resident disc: {credit} — self-hosted, it never goes dead.
player.chartNote: Tracks are drawn from a mood-based playlist, sourced from Apple Music's official previews.
player.fullVersion: Hear it in full on Apple Music ↗
player.previewNote: These are someone else’s songs, so this site plays 30 seconds of each and fades the last second and a half out on purpose — nothing is broken. Like what you hear? Go hear the rest on the platform.
